listing.description: Imagine waking up among the trees, sunlight filtering through the leaves, and the day beginning at a gentler pace. At 6625 Snake Road, nature is your backdrop and midcentury design is the frame. Set in the Montclair hills, this is a home that invites you to breathe a little deeper and feel a world away—all while being close to the village you love.  Inside, warm hardwood floors and designer lighting complement the home’s midcentury character. The living room opens to a spacious, private deck, where morning coffee can turn into an afternoon among the trees. Just outside the kitchen, a charming patio offers another place to linger and dine. The backyard adds even more room to enjoy the outdoors, with space for gardening, dining and play.  On the main level, two bedrooms and an office provide room for both retreat and everyday life. The primary bedroom has a special surprise: a sweet alcove with a beautiful view of nature—a lovely spot to read, reflect or simply take in the view.  Downstairs, a bonus room offers even more possibilities, whether you imagine a guest space, family room, creative retreat or place to play. A full bathroom and laundry room add to the flexibility. The converted garage provides additional space to make your own, with room for a gym, family room or studio, plus a sizable office. It’s a rare gift to have this much flexible space, ready to adapt to the way you live, work and play. A carport provides off-street parking.  When you’re ready to venture out, Montclair Village, local cafés, shops and beautiful trails are all close by. It’s a home that gives you room to settle in, spread out and enjoy the beauty of the hills—while staying connected to everything that makes Montclair so special.

verdict: A genuine 1959 post-and-beam treehouse on a steep Montclair canyon lot: you trade water views, flat yard, and an en-suite primary for strong MCM character, a light-flooded glass-wall great room, and a big flexible lower level at $561/sf — $100k under its own Aug-2022 sale price of $949k. The trade this house IS: character + light + price versus fire-country diligence (Very High FHSZ presumptive, flat roofs, post-supported steep downslope, overhead lines) that must clear insurance and inspection before it becomes a buy.

crosschecks.result: Mostly verified — 'nature backdrop' (p_16, p_27), primary 'alcove with a view' (p_27), 'spacious private deck' (p_16; though neighbor overlooks the deck edge, p_41), 'converted garage + office' (p_36–37), downstairs 'bonus room' (p_33). No water-view claims made — honest listing; MLS 'View: None' actually undersells the real canyon/canopy view. 'Backyard... space for play' is the one stretch: it's a steep wooded slope (p_48–51)

1,051 ft, upper Montclair hills just below the Skyline crest; same Snake Rd micro-market as saved comps 6401-snake (wt 4.2) and 6833-snake (wt 4.0) — this one is the no-water-view, character-and-price play of the three
